summary.text: Elgin Rogers (Elgin Rogers Jr.) is a Democratic state representative from Ohio who has represented District 42 since January 1, 2025, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A former teacher and Lucas County government administrator, he is the ranking member of the Natural Resources Committee.

paragraphs.text: Elgin Rogers Jr. was born in Toledo, Ohio, and graduated from Jesup W. Scott High School, according to Ballotpedia.
He earned a B.A. in political science from Kent State University and a graduate degree from Indiana University.
His career experience includes working as a teacher, as director of multiple departments in the Lucas County auditor's office, and as an administrator with the Lucas County board of commissioners.
Rogers assumed office in the Ohio House of Representatives on January 1, 2025, and advanced from the Democratic primary on May 5, 2026.
In the 2025-2026 session he serves on the Energy, Transportation and House Ways and Means committees and is the ranking member of the Natural Resources Committee.
Robert McMahon (R) is the other candidate in the November 3, 2026 general election.
